title: Using your private ticket reference
summary: Checking and replying to a support request
body:
After creating a support request, copy the private reference shown below the form and keep it safe.

Paste it into “Already have a request?” on this site to read replies, check the current status or send another message. Replies appear on the site; email notifications are not currently sent.

Anyone with the reference can access the request. Keep it private and do not include passwords or payment details in your messages.

title: Checking service availability
summary: Where to find incidents and maintenance updates
body:
Visit status.hngroup.org.uk to see current service availability, maintenance announcements and incident updates.

If your issue is not covered by an existing update, create a support request and describe the affected service, what happened and any error message. Do not send passwords.
